# ENDOCARDITIS WITH HACEK BACTERIA

HACEK bacteria are the fastidious Gram-negative bacilli, including Haemophilus parainfluenzae, Haemophilus paraphrophilus, Haemophilus influenzae, Aggregatibacter aphrophilus (Haemophilus aphrophilus), Actinobacillus actinomycetemcomitans, Cardiobacterium hominis, Eikenella corrodens, Kingella kingae and Kingella denitrificans. It may take up three weeks for the microbiology laboratory to isolate these organisms.

Treatment options are limited for patients with allergies to beta-lactam antibiotics. Consult Infectious Diseases for advice.

# Duration of therapy

Native valve endocarditis (NVE): 4 weeks
Prosthetic valve endocarditis (PVE): 6 weeks

Therapy:
## Treatment

Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h ($) M for 4 weeks (NVE) or 6 weeks (PVE)

## Isolate is susceptible to ampicillin

Ampicillin-sulbactam 3 gm IV q6h ($) R for 4 weeks (NVE) or 6 weeks (PVE)
